scenario: Negation under logical per LLOG.4.2 — `no <pattern> -> emit X logical` is valid and compiles cleanly. The absence of matching facts justifies the logical fact. Pin: `no Motion m where m.state == "on" -> emit QuietHouse logical` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` observes neither the justification nor the lowering. Negation under logical at runtime is logical/LLOG.4.1's.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    state: String key

schema QuietHouse scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule quiet:
    no Motion m where m.state == "on"
->
    emit QuietHouse logical dummy: 1
